notes.title: Crystal Vibes developer's game Squingle launched today!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=DEAbZ4WnujI;full][/previewyoutube]

Before time there was only Squingle 
– and she needs your help to create the Universe!

The spiraling psychedelic VR puzzle – Liquid crystal levels are alive, mystical, and other-worldly, offering a unique multisensory showcase that must be seen, heard and felt to be believed. 

Grab the two revolving orbs and guide them through iridescent mazes that twist and turn, forming structures like DNA. Will you discover the meaning of Squingle?


We've had one media review already, here's what they had to say:

Rated 9.1/10 ~  VR Italia

“One of the most fascinating and original things ever seen in the world of video games.”

“Level design that dwarfs some of the most important AAA studios.”

“Squingle is one of the most beautiful products I have played in the last year of virtual reality, among the heavyweights like Rez Infinite, Thumper and Tetris Effect.”

“It is definitely ahead of everything that has recently been released both on Steam VR and on the official Oculus Quest store.”


Also on Oculus Quest! 
Visit:
www.Squingle.com
